name: A1 SIP Trunk (registering)
host_hint: From your A1 customer data sheet. A1 has several connection variants, so agree the setup with A1.
notes: For the variant with registration. User name, password and addresses are on your A1 customer data sheet. The user name is usually the number with its code, such as +43... Enter the domain from the data sheet as SIP domain. This is the weakest kind of template: it comes from another PBX vendor's guide, not from A1's guideline for this variant. Faxes go over G.711, not T.38.
